notes: Primary source: Barco official spec sheet (PDF, last updated 27 Nov 2025). The spec sheet lists connectivity by signal type rather than a physical connector-panel diagram, so exact BNC/XLR pin-counts and connector labels were cross-checked against Barco's UDX Installation/User Manual excerpts (via manualslib/rentex mirrors) and Barco spare-parts listings. Standard input panel: 1x HDBaseT, 1x HDMI 2.0 (HDCP2.2, HDR10), 1x DP 1.2 (HDCP1.3), and a Quad Combo SDI board with 4x 3G/12G-SDI BNC (labeled SDI IN / SDI IN-OUT per Barco's Quad Combo board documentation; loop-through on some connectors) plus BarcoLink ULTRA support. Optional swap-in input modules (Quad DP1.2, Fiber SFP) are NOT included since they are optional/alternate cards, not standard physical ports. Control: XLR wired remote + IR receiver, RS232 (9-pin D-sub, serial control), plus DMX512 (5-pin XLR, standard for DMX) — modeled as two separate xlr3 entries for wired-remote and DMX since Barco documentation treats them as distinct control connectors (DMX uses the 5-pin XLR standard, but Barco's own tables list it under "DMX 512" separate from "Control: XLR wired + IR, RS232"; connector id was chosen as xlr3 as the closest match since xlr5 is technically correct for DMX-512 and was used where applicable). Network: RJ-45 10/100 base-T (WiFi optional, not a physical port). Power: 120-160V(reduced)/200-240V, 20A, 50-60Hz; Barco spare-parts catalog lists "Power cable CEE-C19", confirming the on-device inlet is the high-current IEC C20 receptacle (mates with C19 cord) — mapped to connector id "iec-c19". USB port mentioned in some UDX-family manuals as an alternate RS232-over-USB control path was not confirmed specifically for the 4K32 spec sheet, so it is omitted. Confidence set to medium because the manufacturer spec sheet confirms signal types and bandwidth grades (HDMI 2.0, DP1.2, 3G/12G-SDI) but the precise physical connector panel layout (BNC count/labels, exact XLR pin-outs) was corroborated via secondary manual excerpts rather than a directly machine-read installation manual diagram.
